messages:
ashwin: Hey team — opened a small PR to add a new tokenizer profile and a tiny config tweak for the gpt-lite onboarding. Can someone take a look when they have a minute? https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/492 :wave:

ashwin: TL;DR: tokenizer change allows preserve_whitespace flag (defaults false) to handle a couple of legacy corpus cases. No model weights changed. Need one approval + green CI to merge. Targeting tomorrow morning rollout (2025-08-05 10:00 PDT).

sasha: taking a look now :eyes:

kelly: quick question — does preserve_whitespace affect token counts significantly? that could change batching heuristics.

ashwin: good call. I ran a small pass over prod-ish sample (10k docs): avg tokens per doc goes from 128.3 -> 129.1 (0.8 increase). P95 unchanged. So should be fine for current batching profiles.

maria: can you paste the perf snippet? want to double-check token billing outcomes for a couple heavy routes.

ashwin: here's the sampling command I used and the tiny output:
```bash
# sample run
python infra/tools/token_stats.py --profile gpt-lite --sample 10000 --preserve-whitespace
# output (truncated)
avg_tokens: 129.1
median_tokens: 56
p95_tokens: 480
```

ashwin: billing delta estimated ~+0.6% for text-gen endpoints that use this tokenizer.

ci-bot: check pipeline v2 #492 — build succeeded, unit tests passed, e2e flaky tests skipped (label: tokenizer).

kelly: thanks — that delta seems fine. I can do a quick review for the config side.

ashwin: appreciate it. note: added a tiny test under tests/tokenizer/test_whitespace.py that covers the new flag.

sasha: looking at the diff now — LGTM on code but please add a short comment in the config JSON explaining why preserve_whitespace exists (to avoid surprise later). small nit.

ashwin: on it, will push a one-line comment.

ashwin: pushed comment and updated PR description to call out the rollout window and perf numbers.

tomas: I can approve after CI is green and kelly signs off on the batching note.

kelly: reviewed and approved. :white_check_mark:

ashwin: awesome — CI is green, merging after 5m unless objections. planning to deploy to staging then monitor for 30m before prod rollback window.

maria: no objections from me. if anything odd, I’ll ping infra oncall. :+1:

ashwin: merged. thanks everyone! :shipit:

ci-bot: PR #492 merged by ashwin at 1753750089
